name: GrimKeep
description:
About This Game

GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.

Big Damage Isn't Rolled. It's Built.

  • Find items and try out different combinations for maximum damage.

  • Roll the dice for powerful combos that fire off your items’ bonuses and multipliers.

  • Tune your bag by acquiring dice with special abilities such as poison, healing or gold.

  • Further enhance your build at the Crucible. Melt items and their abilities into something new.

  • Outsmart the enemies by tactically using your defense, stuns, and heals. Your strategy determines how far you will make it.

  • Use what you learned to optimize your next run, or try a totally different build.

A Rotten Nightmare Fairytale

The city is cursed and you must do what you can to set things right.

  • Choose your path on the map and assess the risks and rewards at every crossroads.

  • You are the hero of this fairytale. Play as The Huntress or The Beast and unlock more characters as you progress. Each with unique strengths to build and tune around.

  • Take a chance at encounters with curious strangers in the city. You may or may not regret it.

What’s In the Game

  • 200+ items with endless combinations

  • 60+ unique monsters

  • 7 playable heroes

  • 7 dice types

  • 30 hero skills to unlock

Made With Love

GrimKeep is made by a small dev team and we’re pouring our hearts into this game! We love to share our (sometimes chaotic) journey with you and always appreciate hearing what you think.
